caveats: Per-decision synergy branches are NOT built: B/R decisions live inside EpisodePolicy's MoveExecutor, and a faithful branch needs that executor state restored at t0 inside the clean3 CRN prefix replay (plus MixedPolicy with the BASE background). The runner logs every cooperative move (descriptive table) but has no decision_branch, so the per-decision decomposition is reported unavailable and its 96,000 sim-s stay unspent. Building it needs N2/N4 owners of the move executor.

The runner has never touched SUMO: policy/native paths reuse the reviewed clean3 final-eval and native-plant bindings plus N1's map install; the u24 run is the first physics. N1's sanity job (clean3_u0 arm) exercises the same accel_plant path earlier.

MAPPO arm swaps only the plant's executor checkpoint; if tools.leverprobe.backend.setup pins the d9042cc5 hash, a retrained executor will be refused at load (episode fails, never retried). Check on cpuV with N7's file before u24 (setup is SUMO-free).

With a mappo_u0 base, BASE = the bound MAPPO comparator; if clean4 started from the transferred u0 but the comparator is the wz3to2 retrain, A-BASE mixes training with the base swap (the T0/T1 labels show which comparator was bound).
